sections.title: Combined deadline timeline
sections.what: Merges assignments, hackathon submissions, and internship deadlines into one list sorted by date, and shows each one with a countdown. Shows a short message when the list is empty.
sections.why: Likely reason: gives one sorted view of every deadline, which matches the card header text.
sections.watch_out: Dates are compared as text and missing dates are pushed to the end, so an entry with no date always appears last.

summary: Shows one date-sorted list that combines assignment due dates, hackathon submission deadlines, and internship application deadlines, each with a live countdown.
purpose: Gives the student one place to see every upcoming academic and career deadline in order.
why: Likely reason: keeps three kinds of deadlines from being spread across separate screens. The sort order is only described by the card header text.
how: Reads the assignment, hackathon, and internship lists from the store. Turns each entry into the same shape, with a title, type, date, colour, and badge. Joins the three lists, sorts them by date, and draws each one as a card with a countdown. If the list is empty, shows a short message instead.
inputs: Assignments (title, due date, due time), hackathons (title, submission deadline or end date), and internships (company, deadline date or apply date) from the store.
outputs: A card titled Combined Academic and Career Timeline, with one row per deadline in date order, or a message that nothing is scheduled.
risks: Sorting compares date text, so dates must use the same year-month-day format. Entries with no date are pushed to the end. Items from different lists can share an id, which can confuse the list. Hackathons and internships have no time, so their countdown uses the default end of day.
debug: If the order looks wrong, check the date format on the source item. If a row is missing, check whether its date is empty. If a countdown shows strange values, check the date (see CountdownTimer). If rows disappear or repeat, check for duplicate ids across the three lists.
